# Getting started

:::tip Before you begin

Make sure you have **Node 20** or later.

:::

Install the CLI:

```bash title="terminal"
npm install --global @acme/cli
```

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="npm">npm</TabItem>
</Tabs>

> [!NOTE]
> GitHub-style alerts are kept exactly as written.

See [the reference][ref] and the [API docs](../api/index.md#auth "API").
